problem: Two distinct intersecting straight lines make both pairs of vertically opposite angles equal.

proof_idea.original: The source applies I.13 to two adjacent sums and subtracts the common angle using C.N.3.
proof_idea.analytic: Reuse independently checked metric vertical-angle relation, prove its measure bridge, or use opposite-ray supplemental sums and subtraction.

litex_code:
# Book I.15: both pairs of vertical angles at a genuine line intersection are equal.
thm proposition_15:
    ? forall a, b, c, d, o cart(R, R):
        a != b
        c != d
        $geometry::main::is_on_segment(o, a, b)
        a != o
        b != o
        $geometry::main::is_on_segment(o, c, d)
        c != o
        d != o
        not $geometry::main::is_collinear(a, o, c)
        =>:
            ray_angle(a, o, c) = ray_angle(b, o, d)
            ray_angle(a, o, d) = ray_angle(b, o, c)
    release thm vertical_angles_equal(a, b, c, d, o)
    by thm angle_relation_implies_equal_measure(a, o, c, b, o, d) => ray_angle(a, o, c) = ray_angle(b, o, d)
    release thm segment_membership_reverses_endpoints(o, c, d)
    release thm vertical_angles_equal(a, b, d, c, o)
    by thm angle_relation_implies_equal_measure(a, o, d, b, o, c) => ray_angle(a, o, d) = ray_angle(b, o, c)
